verdict.rationale: Fellow publishes an extensive REST API reference (endpoints, headers, pagination, webhooks) hosted at developers.fellow.ai/reference/*, which is consistent with a ReadMe.io-style docs site, but there is no explicit evidence of a 'try it now' interactive console or runnable code examples, and a probe for a standard OpenAPI/Swagger spec returned 404s. Missing for 10: confirmed interactive 'try it' functionality, sample runnable code snippets in multiple languages, and a public machine-readable API spec.
